abstract: This paper studies the long-run impacts of diasporas on local economic development. We do so in the context of one of the most economically influential diasporas: the ethnic Chinese in Southeast Asia. Our instrumental variables strategy exploits 15th-century landing sites on Java that shaped subsequent Chinese settlement but lost maritime access due to 17th-century silting. We find that a 1p.p. higher Chinese share in 1930 leads to 9.4% higher household consumption and 26% higher population today. These effects attenuate sharply during the 1997-1998 crisis, then recover. We find strong effects on firm sales driven by improved financing through local private networks but not through exports. We provide suggestive evidence for the key role of historical ethnic-trading networks within Java. Our findings suggest that despite their small size, ethnic minorities with durable complementarities can play an out-sized, positive role in local economic development.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了海外移民对地方经济发展的长期影响。我们以东南亚的华裔族群为背景，这是最具经济影响力的移民群体之一。我们的工具变量策略利用了15世纪爪哇岛的登陆点，这些登陆点塑造了后续华人定居格局，但因17世纪泥沙淤积而失去了海上通道。我们发现，1930年华裔比例每提高1个百分点，当今家庭消费增加9.4%，人口增加26%。这些影响在1997-1998年危机期间急剧减弱，随后恢复。我们发现，通过本地私人网络改善融资对企业销售有显著影响，但出口渠道并无此效应。我们提供了暗示性证据，表明爪哇岛内历史族裔贸易网络的关键作用。我们的研究结果表明，尽管少数族裔规模较小，但具有持久互补性的族裔群体能在地方经济发展中发挥超乎比例的积极作用。

title: Communities of Commerce: The Legacy of Chinese Immigration on Java

abstract: Accounting for multiple responses to weather shocks drastically changes policy implications for adaptation to increasingly variable weather. Kenyan households react to temperature anomalies by sending migrants, by transiting to less climate-sensitive occupations, and by changing livestock species. Evidence suggests these are short-term adjustments, which respond significantly to common interventions. Randomised income transfers cushion consumption losses and decrease adaptation pressure, such as migration. Better infrastructure, instead, eases occupational transitions, reducing alternative adjustments, including migration and livestock composition. A model of joint migration, occupation, and livestock choices reveals long-term effects of these short-term shocks. Transitions to non-agriculture first act as a substitute for migration and subsequently as a stepping stone for later migration.
abstract_zh: 考虑对天气冲击的多重反应，会极大地改变针对日益多变气候的适应政策含义。肯尼亚家庭通过迁移移民、转向对气候敏感度较低的职业以及改变牲畜种类来应对温度异常。证据表明，这些是短期调整，且对常见干预措施反应显著。随机收入转移缓解了消费损失，并降低了适应压力，如迁移。相反，更好的基础设施则促进了职业转换，减少了包括迁移和牲畜构成在内的其他调整方式。一个联合迁移、职业和牲畜选择的模型揭示了这些短期冲击的长期效应。向非农业的转变起初作为迁移的替代，随后成为后续迁移的跳板。
title: Coping with weather shocks

abstract: I show that falling world agricultural prices increased the likelihood of civil war onset during 1957–2007, especially in Sub-Saharan Africa. A one-standard-deviation price decline raised the likelihood of onset by around 30 percent in the global sample of 118 countries and by around 45 percent in Sub-Saharan Africa, relative to average onset rates of around 2 percent per year. I reconcile these findings with earlier mixed results by showing that the estimated effect depends on how country-specific price indices are constructed. Price indices that isolate changes in world commodity prices yield statistically significant effects, whereas indices conflating price changes with changes in countries’ exports do not. The effect of world prices on civil war onset operated through agricultural producers rather than food consumers. Estimates are essentially unchanged when I control for consumer food-price shocks, and effects are substantially larger among countries whose agricultural exports consist mainly of cash crops. This points to an opportunity-cost channel whereby falling prices depress producer incomes and lower the opportunity cost of joining armed conflict. Export data for low- and middle-income countries are often measured with error. I develop an analysis of measurement error in year-by-year export shares and show that period-average export shares permit consistent estimation.
abstract_zh: 我证明，1957年至2007年间，世界农产品价格下跌增加了内战爆发的可能性，尤其是在撒哈拉以南非洲地区。在包含118个国家的全球样本中，价格一个标准差的下滑使爆发可能性相对于每年约2%的平均爆发率上升了约30%；而在撒哈拉以南非洲，这一增幅约为45%。我将这些发现与此前混杂的结果相调和，表明估计效应取决于国家特定价格指数的构建方式。仅隔离世界商品价格变动的指数产生了统计上显著的影响，而将价格变动与国家出口变动混为一谈的指数则不然。世界价格对内战爆发的影响是通过农业生产者而非食品消费者传导的。当我控制消费者食品价格冲击时，估计结果基本不变，且在以经济作物为主要农业出口的国家中，效应显著更大。这指向一种机会成本渠道，即价格下跌压低生产者收入，降低了加入武装冲突的机会成本。低收入和中等收入国家的出口数据常存在测量误差。我开发了一种针对逐年出口份额测量误差的分析方法，并表明期间平均出口份额能够实现一致估计。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为全球118个国家及撒哈拉以南非洲，数据与制度背景均非中国，核心应用不涉及中国、中国企业或中国地区。
title: World Agricultural Prices and the Onset of Civil War
title_zh: DP21829 世界农产品价格与内战爆发

abstract: Elites maintain disproportionate political power even in formally inclusive political systems, yet the institutions through which they coordinate and reproduce this advantage remain poorly understood. We study membership in the Buenos Aires Jockey Club---Argentina's most prominent elite social club---exploiting staggered variation in family entry. Using difference-in-differences techniques, we find that Jockey Club membership increased the probability of holding legislative office by approximately four percentage points---more than twice the control-group mean. Consistent with a network-based mechanism, membership also increased families' centrality in elite marriage networks---a resource that can facilitate political success through access to party nominations and voter mobilization. This electoral advantage declines substantially after the 1912 Sáenz Peña democratizing reforms, suggesting that the political returns to club membership are conditional on institutional contexts that make elite network connections valuable. Our findings shed light on how elite social institutions reproduce political inequality where personal connections are essential for accessing political office.
abstract_zh: 精英即使在形式上包容的政治体系中，也维持着不成比例的政治权力，然而，他们协调并再生产这一优势的制度机制仍鲜为人知。我们研究了布宜诺斯艾利斯赛马俱乐部——阿根廷最显赫的精英社交俱乐部——的会员资格，利用家族入会时间的交错变化进行实证分析。采用双重差分方法，我们发现赛马俱乐部会员资格使担任立法职务的概率提高了约四个百分点，这一增幅超过对照组均值的两倍。与基于网络的机制相一致，会员资格还增强了家族在精英婚姻网络中的中心性——这一资源可通过获取政党提名和选民动员来促进政治成功。这一选举优势在1912年萨恩斯·佩尼亚民主化改革后显著减弱，表明俱乐部会员资格的政治回报取决于使精英网络联系具有价值的制度环境。我们的研究揭示了精英社会制度如何在个人关系对获取政治职位至关重要的条件下再生产政治不平等。
title: Social Clubs and Political Office
title_zh: DP21828 社交俱乐部与政治职务

abstract: This study examines the income loss following forced CEO turnovers using income data from the official records at the Danish Tax Authority. We find that dismissed CEOs’ personal income is 40% lower in the five years following forced turnovers. The decline is driven by labor market outcomes: labor and entrepreneurial incomes decline, while other sources of income increase. We find larger declines in income for executives with poor performance during their tenures, consistent with the executive labor market being the main channel for the lower income. Overall, the findings suggest that executives face significant personal costs from forced turnovers.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用丹麦税务局官方记录的收入数据，考察了强制CEO更替后的收入损失。我们发现，被解雇CEO在强制更替后五年内的个人收入降低了40%。这一下降主要由劳动力市场结果驱动：劳动收入和创业收入减少，而其他收入来源增加。我们发现，任期内表现不佳的高管收入下降幅度更大，这与高管劳动力市场是收入降低的主要渠道相一致。总体而言，研究结果表明，高管因强制更替而面临显著的个人成本。
title: Personal Costs of Executive Turnovers

abstract: Predictions of the effects of AI on the economy and society tend to focus on productivity growth, job losses, and shifts in the distribution of income. This column examines various potential scenarios for the macroeconomic effects of AI, using Congressional Budget Office projections to estimate their effects on the US federal budget, and discusses their implications for US fiscal policy. The conclusions show that the fiscal consequences of AI will depend not only on how much it raises national income, but also on who receives that income and how policymakers respond.
abstract_zh: 关于人工智能对经济和社会影响的预测，通常聚焦于生产率增长、就业损失以及收入分配的变化。本文利用国会预算办公室的预测，考察了人工智能对宏观经济影响的各种潜在情景，以估算其对美国联邦预算的影响，并探讨了这些影响对美国财政政策的启示。结论表明，人工智能的财政后果不仅取决于其提高国民收入的程度，还取决于谁获得这些收入以及政策制定者如何应对。
authors: Karen Dynan, Douglas Elmendorf, Louise Sheiner
title: How the rise of AI matters for fiscal policy
title_zh: 人工智能崛起对财政政策的影响

abstract: Employment polarisation – the decline of middle-skill routine occupations relative to both ends of the skill distribution – is usually documented from repeated cross-sections. However, the time evolution of cross-sections is driven by workers’ flows across occupational categories and in and out of the labour market. Drawing on an administrative panel that follows French workers over 1984–2021, this column shows that polarisation emerged through a collapse in entry into routine jobs from non-employment, not through displacement of incumbent routine workers. The findings redirect policy attention from protecting existing jobs towards the entry margin.
abstract_zh: 就业极化——即中等技能常规职业相对于技能分布两端的衰退——通常通过重复截面数据加以记录。然而，截面的时间演变是由工人在职业类别间的流动以及进出劳动力市场的动态所驱动的。基于追踪法国工人1984年至2021年情况的行政面板数据，本专栏表明，极化现象源于非就业状态进入常规职业的通道崩溃，而非现有常规工人的被迫转移。研究结果将政策关注点从保护现有就业转向进入环节。
authors: Fabio Cerina, Elisa Dienesch, Alexander Monge-Naranjo, Alessio Moro
title: The anatomy of job polarisation: Evidence from four decades of French worker flows
title_zh: 工作两极化的解剖：来自法国工人流动四十年数据的证据
